About Our Bakery

We believe good food brings people together. Every product is prepared with care using quality ingredients and traditional baking techniques.

Made Fresh Every Day

Rayton Home Bakery is a local bakery focused on fresh bread, handmade pastries and beautiful cakes for every occasion.

Whether you are grabbing breakfast on the way to work, celebrating a birthday or simply looking for something sweet, we have something for you.

Our mission: To provide delicious, affordable and freshly baked products while creating a welcoming experience for every customer.

Our vision: To become a trusted local bakery known for quality, creativity and excellent customer service.
